sentences.text: Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) stated confidentiality rules: 'what we talk about stays between us and your GP, unless I'm worried about someone's safety, and then I'd tell you'
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported Mason's toys were out, creating a mess.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported Lily was down for the day.
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) identified the visit as Lily's eight month review.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported Lily eats porridge in the morning, mashed veg at dinner, and is on four bottles.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported each bottle contains seven ounces.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported Lily sometimes does not finish the night bottle.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported Lily tries finger foods including bits of toast and banana.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported Lily gags when trying finger foods, stating 'it freaks me out'.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported Lily goes down to sleep around seven and wakes once around three for a bottle.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported Mason sleeps worse than Lily.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported Dean works Monday to Friday on lorries and returns on weekends.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported she is alone with the children during the week.
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) reported Lily's previous weight was seven point nine kilos.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported Lily feels heavier and is in nine to twelve months clothes.
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) recorded Lily's current weight as eight point four kilos.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported Lily is sitting on her own and trying to crawl.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported Lily goes backwards when trying to crawl.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported no worries about Lily's hearing or eyes, noting she turns round when Mason screams.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported her mood is 'Alright', but she is 'Tired' and 'Bored, sometimes, in the evenings'.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) disclosed drinking alcohol: 'a bottle of wine a night, if I'm honest', clarifying 'Most nights, yeah' and 'Well, a bottle of wine when they're in bed'.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) confirmed the bottle size is 'the normal ones from the Co-op' (seventy-five centilitres).
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported starting the bottle 'about eight, once they're down' (referring to the children).
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) disclosed smoking weed: 'I smoke a bit of weed. Only when the kids are in bed, never in front of them'.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported smoking frequency as 'Couple of nights a week, a joint or two'.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported smoking location as 'in the garden, out the back door, so it's not in the house'.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) denied using cocaine, stating 'No. Never. I've never done coke, not once, I wouldn.'
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported falling asleep on the sofa while Lily was crying, stating 'I didn't hear her straight away'.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported Mason woke her up and came downstairs saying 'Lily's crying'.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported she does not know how long Lily was crying.
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) proposed letting the GP know and referring the mother to the Harbridge Recovery Hub.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) agreed to the referral, stating 'Yeah. I suppose.'
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) stated she would speak to her safeguarding lead and ring the mother tomorrow.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) stated 'They're not taking my kids'.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported her mum lives on Thornfield Road.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported her mum has Mason on Tuesdays.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported Mason attends Little Acorns for fifteen hours.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) reported finances are tight, relying on Universal Credit and Dean's money, with electricity costs up due to a key meter.
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) provided the Harbridge energy fund number and the choking leaflet.
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) proposed the mother stop drinking and stop using weed on nights she is alone with the children.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) agreed to the plan, stating 'I can try. I'll get rid of the wine in the fridge'.
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) proposed the mother's mum stay over on Wednesday and Thursday.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) confirmed her mum offered to stay on Wednesday and Thursday.
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) stated Lily must sleep in her cot, never on the sofa, especially if the mother has had a drink.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) confirmed Lily is always in her cot.
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) stated she would make the Recovery Hub referral and write to Dr Anand at Elm Street surgery.
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) stated she would ring the mother tomorrow after speaking to her safeguarding lead.
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) scheduled a follow-up visit on the eighth of December.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) confirmed the eighth of December is a Tuesday.
Health visitor Claire Dunmore (S1) instructed the mother to ring her mum about the Wednesday and Thursday care.
Mother Jade Pritchard (S2) stated she would text her mum while the health visitor is present.
